description: Set Candidate Criteria. Use this to configure or update your target role, core skills, minimum salary floor, remote policy, and dealbreakers on your private outreach desk.

dealbreakers.description: Non-negotiable constraints that automatically rule out a pitch (e.g. 'Onsite required', 'Legacy Java').

desk_key.description: The secret desk_key returned when the desk was created. It is the only credential for this desk and cannot be recovered.

salary_floor.description: Minimum acceptable annual base salary in USD.

skills.description: List of core required skills or technical focus areas.

target_role.description: Target job title or seniority level (e.g. 'Staff Distributed Systems Engineer').

name: set_criteria
title: Set Candidate Criteria
